violations.why: ISR is enabled and can fire between the two task reads, changing v_quiver so they return different values.
The ISR is unmasked between line 38 and disable_isr at line 40 (and during idlerun), so it can write v_willow between the reads.
The ISR is re-enabled at line 43, so it can run after the read at 44 and before the disable at 48, changing v_willow before the read at 52.
After enable_isr at line 43 the ISR can set v_garnet to 0, so the check at line 49 can see a different value than the check at line 41.
